notes: Verified against the real archived 2025-26 bulletin (raw HTML fetched and parsed table-by-table, not WebFetch's summary, per this session's cross-check policy). Course codes, credits, and prerequisisite structure are unaffected by the rename (titles aren't modeled in this schema), so the semesters array below is unchanged from 2026.
